module_summary: SERV bit-serial memory interface helper that generates Wishbone byte selects, misalignment flag, and sign/zero-extends load data via a sticky sign-bit register.

anchors.name: i_bufreg2_q
anchors.why: Serial load data from bufreg2; source of o_rd and sign bit.

anchors.name: o_rd
anchors.why: Serial rd write data: load bit or sign/zero extension.

anchors.name: o_wb_sel
anchors.why: Wishbone byte-lane select decoded from address LSBs and access size.

anchors.name: dat_valid
anchors.why: Selects load data vs sign extension for o_rd; enables signbit capture.

anchors.name: signbit
anchors.why: Holds last valid data bit for sign extension of narrow loads.

anchors.name: o_misalign
anchors.why: Reports misaligned word/half access from address LSBs.

anchors.name: i_lsb
anchors.why: Address low bits deciding byte lanes and misalignment.

anchors.name: i_bytecnt
anchors.why: External byte counter input deciding when data bits are valid.

anchors.name: i_word
anchors.why: Word-size access command affecting byte selects and data validity.

anchors.name: i_half
anchors.why: Halfword access command affecting byte selects and data validity.

anchors.name: i_signed
anchors.why: Selects sign vs zero extension of loaded data.

groups.name: Load data extension
groups.description: Passes valid load bits to rd else sign/zero extension from signbit.

groups.name: Byte select and alignment
groups.description: Decodes address LSBs and size into wb_sel and misalignment flag.
